recent_articles.title: Israel plan to seize more of Gaza means 'more children will suffer': UN - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Benjamin Netanyahu**, the Israeli Prime Minister, has ordered his military to take control of 70% of the Gaza Strip, defying a fragile ceasefire agreement. **Unicef** warned that this expansion will worsen the already dire health crisis for children in Gaza, who are suffering from overcrowding, lack of food and water, and inadequate hygiene.  The agency cited reports of rats biting children, bacterial infections, and limited access to healthcare facilities. The Palestinian foreign ministry condemned Netanyahu's decision as a violation of the ceasefire terms.

recent_articles.title: Russian rate of losses in Ukraine almost triples in one year | Russia-Ukraine war News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Russia's** territorial gains in Ukraine have slowed significantly, with the **US Defence Intelligence Agency (DIA)** reporting a net advance of only 104 square kilometers between January and May 2026 compared to 1,619 square kilometers last year.  The **Institute for the Study of War (ISW)** attributes this decline to Ukraine's successful counteroffensive, which has seen it reclaim territory previously occupied by **Russia**. The Ukrainian military has also intensified its efforts to disrupt **Russian** logistics and supply lines, while simultaneously targeting key infrastructure like oil depots and airbases.  **Ukraine** continues to receive support from allies such as **Sweden**, which will donate 16 Gripen fighter jets.  Meanwhile, **Russia** has escalated attacks on Ukrainian cities, including Kyiv, with the aim of striking military targets and potentially retaliating for alleged attacks on civilian infrastructure.

recent_articles.title: Nato ready to defend ‘every inch’ of territory as Russian drone hits Romania | Romania | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nato** Secretary General, **Mark Rutte**, stated that the alliance is prepared to defend its territory after a Russian drone attack on an apartment building in Romania.  **Romania's** President, **Nicuşor Dan**, convened an emergency meeting and summoned Russia's ambassador following the incident which injured two people. The incident prompted condemnation from various international organizations including **France's** Foreign Minister, **Jean-Noël Barrot**, and the **European Commission's** President, **Ursula von der Leyen**.  The incident has raised concerns about Russia's wider campaign of hybrid warfare across Europe.

recent_articles.title: Israel, Russia among new additions on UN sexual violence ‘blacklist’ | Sexual Assault News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The United Nations added **Israel** and **Russia** to a blacklist of countries suspected of committing sexual violence against civilians. The report, released on Friday, verified nearly 10,000 cases of conflict-related sexual violence worldwide last year, with the UN citing "credible information" regarding sexual violence committed by Israeli security forces against Palestinian detainees in prisons and other detention centers. **Pramila Patten**, the UN official who authored the report, stated that the increase in cases is attributed to a record number of violent conflicts and a lack of accountability for perpetrators.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan firmly committed to stance on Palestine, Israel: Dar answers question on Abraham Accords - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ishaq Dar**, Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister, stated that Pakistan remains steadfast in its stance on Palestine and Gaza, emphasizing the need for Israel to establish an independent Palestinian state before any change in Pakistan's position towards Israel. During his meeting with US Senator Marco Rubio, Dar discussed regional security issues, including Pakistan's mediation efforts between Iran and the United States.  **Rubio** expressed appreciation for Pakistan's role in easing tensions between Iran and the United States and acknowledged Pakistan's commitment to peace and stability in the region. The two leaders agreed on strengthening bilateral cooperation in areas like trade, investment, security, and counter-terrorism.

recent_articles.title: UN adds Israel and Russia to blacklist for sexual violence in conflict | United Nations | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **UN** has added **Israel** and **Russia** to a blacklist for sexual violence in conflict, citing abuse by security forces. The report verified 310 cases of Russian abuse, including rape and gang-rape, genital mutilation, and electric shocks, while the UN also documented nine cases of Israeli force-related sexual violence, mostly targeting men or boys from Gaza. **Israel** has denied the use of sexual violence by its military and barred UN experts from detention centers, while **Russia** obstructed investigations into "systemic" sexual violence against Ukrainians.

recent_articles.title: Can the second coming of Tony Abbott resurrect the Liberal party? Or is it another step towards ‘self-destruction’ | Tony Abbott | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Angus Taylor**, the newly appointed leader of the **Liberal** party, has chosen **Tony Abbott** as president to help revive the struggling party.  Abbott's return to active politics comes after a seven-year absence and is expected to influence policy decisions, particularly on immigration and cultural issues.  While some Liberals welcome Abbott's leadership and his potential to address their concerns, others fear he will become a divisive figure within the party, potentially hindering its chances of winning elections. The appointment has sparked debate about whether Abbott's hardline views will resonate with voters and if he can effectively lead the party back to power.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **T.T.V. recent_articles.title: Five killed in Lebanon as Israeli forces advance across key Litani River | Israel attacks Lebanon News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Israeli** forces crossed the Litani River in Lebanon, escalating their ground offensive. At least five people were killed in Israeli air strikes targeting southern Lebanese towns, including Abbasiyeh and Deir Qanoun al-Nahr. The attacks come amid intensified violence following a ceasefire extension that began on May 17th. **Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu** visited troops near the border, confirming Israel's advance into Lebanon.  The **United Nations Children’s Agency (UNICEF)** reported that over 15 children have been killed and 62 injured in the past seven days alone, with an average of 11 children killed or injured every 24 hours.  **Lebanon** is demanding a ceasefire from **Israel**, while humanitarian organizations fear they may be forced to withdraw from southern Lebanon due to ongoing attacks.

recent_articles.title: First of trapped men rescued from flooded Laos cave | Laos | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **International** diving teams, including those who worked on the 2018 Thai cave rescue, have been working tirelessly to free seven men trapped in a flooded cave in Laos for over a week.  The first man was successfully rescued and is safe, but four remain inside a chamber about 300 meters from the entrance. **Josh Richards**, an Australian cave diver, stated that rescuers plan to attempt to bring out the remaining four men tomorrow. The rescue operation faces challenges due to unstable walls and flooding, requiring skilled divers to navigate narrow passages in murky water.  Additional divers are expected to arrive on Friday, while heavy machinery is being used to clear a route to the site.

recent_articles.title: Canadian man admits sending ‘suicide packets’ to hundreds of people around world | Canada | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kenneth Law**, a 60-year-old Canadian man, pleaded guilty to 14 counts of assisting suicide in a Newmarket, Ontario courtroom.  Law admitted to sending lethal substances to people across the globe, including the UK and US, leading to the deaths of 79 individuals. The case has highlighted challenges in policing online forums that promote suicide and sell fatal substances. Law's sentencing is expected in September after prosecutors agreed to withdraw murder charges.  Families in the UK have called for a public inquiry into his actions.

recent_articles.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law who sold toxic chemicals online admits aiding suicides
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A Canadian man, **Kenneth Law**, 60, pleaded guilty to aiding suicides in an Ontario court after admitting to selling toxic chemicals online to people across the world.  **Law** sold about 1,200 packages of the substances to recipients who met him in online suicide forums and is linked to the deaths of 79 Britons. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) in the UK said that due to legal complexities, **Law** would not face charges there, but a successful extradition was deemed unlikely.  The CPS will consider the losses of UK families when sentencing **Law**, who also faces charges in Canada for aiding suicides and murder.

recent_articles.title: French prosecutors to probe Israeli treatment of flotilla activists | Israel-Palestine conflict News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **French** public prosecutor will investigate **Israel’s** treatment of French nationals arrested during the interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla.  **French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot** stated that he believes the alleged abuse, including sexual violence and beatings, may constitute criminal offences.  **Barrot** has banned **Israeli** National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir from entering France after a video surfaced of him taunting activists.
